subject.title: feat(gateway): watched sessions in presence with viewer facepiles

question: Should authenticated user-client presence intentionally become one row per connection so watched sessions remain truthful across multiple tabs, with UI consumers expected to group those rows by `user.id`?
rationale: That presence-model change is necessary for the proposed collaboration UX but is a durable gateway contract decision that cannot be resolved from branch tests alone.

options.title: Approve the per-connection contract
options.body: Accept per-connection presence as the canonical gateway fact, with clients grouping by identity when they want person-level presentation.

options.title: Preserve instance-level presence
options.body: Keep one row per instance and design a separate representation for multiple watched sessions or tabs before landing this UI.

recommendation.title: Approve the per-connection contract
recommendation.body: Accept per-connection presence as the canonical gateway fact, with clients grouping by identity when they want person-level presentation.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the identity/presence foundation and authored this linked increment of the stated program.
